intro: Dear Founders, Investors, and Friends, The Senate Ag Committee advances a crypto bill establishing CFTC regulatory authority. Andre Cronje's Flying Tulip raises additional $75.5 million at $1 billion valuation while Propy secures $100 million for its AI-powered closing platform.

top_signals.title: Senate Ag Committee advances crypto bill to establish CFTC regulatory authority
top_signals.summary: The Senate Agriculture Committee voted 12-11 along party lines to advance the Digital Commodity Intermediaries Act. This bill grants the Commodity Futures Trading Commission primary regulatory authority over digital commodities and spot markets while establishing consumer protections. Chairman John Boozman led the effort after bipartisan talks with Senator Cory Booker failed due to policy disagreements and ethics concerns over public officials in crypto. The measure now heads to the Senate Banking Committee for merger with SEC provisions, potentially clarifying U.S. crypto rules and boosting market innovation.

top_signals.title: Andre Cronje's Flying Tulip raises additional $75.5 million at $1 billion token valuation
top_signals.summary: Andre Cronje's new DeFi platform Flying Tulip raised an additional $75.5 million through token sales. The funding values the platform at $1 billion fully diluted. Cronje, known for Yearn Finance, leads this project targeting decentralized finance users. The raise signals strong investor confidence in DeFi amid market volatility, potentially driving liquidity and new protocols.

top_signals.title: Propy secures $100 million for AI-powered closing platform
top_signals.summary: Propy secured $100 million in funding to build an AI-powered closing platform for real estate. The capital will consolidate title and escrow companies into an end-to-end tokenized system. Propy specializes in blockchain-based property transactions. This investment advances real-world asset tokenization, easing closings and expanding crypto into traditional markets.

top_signals.title: TheDAO startet als Ethereum Security Fund mit 220 Millionen Dollar neu
top_signals.summary: TheDAO is relaunching as an Ethereum Security Fund with $220 million from unclaimed ETH of the original 2016 hack. The project repurposes dormant funds to bolster Ethereum network security. Backers include Ethereum stakeholders recovering lost value. It matters for Ethereum investors as it enhances protocol defenses without new capital raises.

top_signals.title: Talos Extends Series B to $150M with Robinhood, Sony Backing
top_signals.summary: Talos extended its Series B funding to $150 million with $45 million more from new investors including Robinhood and Sony Innovation Fund. Talos provides institutional crypto trading infrastructure. The round involves prominent backers amid growing demand for reliable platforms. It underscores institutional adoption, improving liquidity and tools for crypto investors.

top_signals.title: Escape Velocity Raises $62M DePIN Fund Even as Crypto VC Slows
top_signals.summary: Escape Velocity raised $62 million for its second fund focused on DePIN projects. DePIN builds physical infrastructure via crypto incentives like decentralized networks. The fund persists despite broader crypto VC slowdowns. It offers investors exposure to real-world utility plays in a cautious market.
